about: Front PT0: Brazilian Portuguese strings that may equal their English source, each with a reason (plan front-i18n-pt-br.md §3.3). Keys are the lint's string ids: `catalog:<key>`, `map:<id>.<path>`, `original:<normalised original>`.

entries.catalog:app.name: product name (OpenVireo)
entries.catalog:instructorMode.optionsClosedOk: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
entries.map:helpMenu.ok: the same word in Portuguese (OK, as Windows pt-BR writes it)
entries.map:languageChoice.legend: bilingual on purpose so either reader finds the selector (Idioma is also the Portuguese word)
entries.map:appShell.toolsMenu: «Menu» is the Portuguese word too: the phone menu button, short enough for 320 px
